articles.title: Bitcoin’s quantum dilemma: Bigger blocks or STARK proofs?
articles.snippet: Dealing with large post quantum signatures slowing down Bitcoin can be solved with bigger blocks, or aggregating signatures using STARK proofs.

articles.title: BNB Chain Plans New Layer-1 for AI Agents and Quantum Future
articles.snippet: The network’s 2026 roadmap targets faster transactions, AI-powered apps, and infrastructure aimed at competing with traditional financial systems, while preparing for a quantum future.
